qualifications: For MG-branded passenger vehicles first registered on/after 1 July 2025, for non-commercial use. Commercial use is 7 years/160,000 km; light-commercial policy differs and is not applied here.

Starts at first registration. Retailed 1 August 2024–30 June 2025 vehicles have a different 10 year / 250,000 km policy; retailed before 1 August 2024 different 7 year policy. Confirm start date for any previously registered residual unit.

Separate service-activated extension: up to 10 years/250,000 km only if all scheduled services are at authorised MG dealers within 30 days/2,000 km. Standard cover allows suitably qualified Australian repairers; independent-service records must be uploaded to maker portal within 10 days.

High-voltage battery has separate 7 year / 150,000 km terms. Soft-top/convertible-roof components are 5 years; air suspension/four-wheel steering 5 years/unlimited; other wear, 12 V and component exclusions apply. Statutory consumer rights remain.

qualifications: For MG-branded passenger vehicles first registered on/after 1 July 2025, for non-commercial use. Commercial use is 7 years/160,000 km; light-commercial policy differs and is not applied here.

Starts at first registration. Retailed 1 August 2024–30 June 2025 vehicles have a different 10 year / 250,000 km policy; retailed before 1 August 2024 different 7 year policy. Confirm start date for any previously registered residual unit.

Separate service-activated extension: up to 10 years/250,000 km only if all scheduled services are at authorised MG dealers within 30 days/2,000 km. Standard cover allows suitably qualified Australian repairers; independent-service records must be uploaded to maker portal within 10 days.

High-voltage battery has separate 7 year / 150,000 km terms. Soft-top/convertible-roof components are 5 years; air suspension/four-wheel steering 5 years/unlimited; other wear, 12 V and component exclusions apply. Statutory consumer rights remain.

qualifications: For MG-branded passenger vehicles first registered on/after 1 July 2025, for non-commercial use. Commercial use is 7 years/160,000 km; light-commercial policy differs and is not applied here.

qualifications: For MG-branded passenger vehicles first registered on/after 1 July 2025, for non-commercial use. Commercial use is 7 years/160,000 km; light-commercial policy differs and is not applied here.

Starts at first registration. Retailed 1 August 2024–30 June 2025 vehicles have a different 10 year / 250,000 km policy; retailed before 1 August 2024 different 7 year policy. Confirm start date for any previously registered residual unit.

Separate service-activated extension: up to 10 years/250,000 km only if all scheduled services are at authorised MG dealers within 30 days/2,000 km. Standard cover allows suitably qualified Australian repairers; independent-service records must be uploaded to maker portal within 10 days.

High-voltage battery has separate 7 year / 150,000 km terms. Soft-top/convertible-roof components are 5 years; air suspension/four-wheel steering 5 years/unlimited; other wear, 12 V and component exclusions apply. Statutory consumer rights remain.

expected.label: Vehicle warranty
expected.scope: MG Australia private-buyer policy baseline for explicitly enumerated applicable versions; registration-date, commercial-use and component exceptions retained
qualifications: For MG-branded passenger vehicles first registered on/after 1 July 2025, for non-commercial use. Commercial use is 7 years/160,000 km; light-commercial policy differs and is not applied here.

Starts at first registration. Retailed 1 August 2024–30 June 2025 vehicles have a different 10 year / 250,000 km policy; retailed before 1 August 2024 different 7 year policy. Confirm start date for any previously registered residual unit.

Separate service-activated extension: up to 10 years/250,000 km only if all scheduled services are at authorised MG dealers within 30 days/2,000 km. Standard cover allows suitably qualified Australian repairers; independent-service records must be uploaded to maker portal within 10 days.

High-voltage battery has separate 7 year / 150,000 km terms. Soft-top/convertible-roof components are 5 years; air suspension/four-wheel steering 5 years/unlimited; other wear, 12 V and component exclusions apply. Statutory consumer rights remain.

gradeReview.reason: Current Australian MG passenger private-use standard warranty is expressly 7 years/unlimited; dealer-only servicing is needed for the separate extension, not used to downgrade this standard baseline.

qualifications: For MG-branded passenger vehicles first registered on/after 1 July 2025, for non-commercial use. Commercial use is 7 years/160,000 km; light-commercial policy differs and is not applied here.
